content.title: What time is UConn vs South Carolina in Final Four? Start time, location, TV Channel
content.text: Updated April 3, 2026, 8:28 p.m. ETWhat started with 68 teams a week ago is down to the Final Four as the women's NCAA Tournament is just a few days away from producing a Final Four. Already we've seen contenders like Iowa, West Virginia and Tennessee knocked out.
